name: Haldane McCall Plc
source: CRON 2026-11-21: Haldane McCall Plc unaudited statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the period ended 30 September 2026 (NGX doclib filing library, page 7), Sept-26 column, printed in naira. Revenue less Cost of Sales equals the printed gross profit of 1,206,185,169; gross profit plus the printed other operating income of 348,800,000 less the printed other operating expenses of 704,821,699 equals the printed operating profit of 850,163,471; operating profit less finance cost of 30,666,317 equals profit before tax of 819,497,154, and profit before tax less income tax of 278,629,032 equals the printed profit of 540,868,122. | NGX doclib: Haldane McCall Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (statement of comprehensive income and five year financial summary, N'000) | CRON 20261025: Net Finance Costs stored as nil for FY2025 and FY2024 from the audited financial statements of Haldane McCall Plc for the year ended 31 December 2025, statement of comprehensive income, where the Finance cost line is printed as a dash in both columns. The statement also confirms the stored figures: Revenue 2,276,222, Cost of Sales 471,016, Gross Profit 1,805,206, Other operating income 3,208 and Administrative Expenses 1,053,515 sum to an Operating profit of 754,899, which equals Profit before Taxation because finance cost is nil, and tax of 112,438 leaves Profit for the year of 642,461 (thousands of naira). The same report covers only FY2025 and FY2024, so FY2023 and earlier operating expenses stay blank.

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
nameNote: the statement carried only its ticker as the name; the name is taken from the exchange listing for HMCALL
periods_note: profit before tax and profit after tax for FY2023 to FY2021 come from the audited five year financial summary. Operating profit left empty for those years because the summary discloses no finance cost line, so EBIT cannot be stated without assuming it.
